Name: Failed Quests Lose Friendship
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
[size=4]Content

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Failing to complete a quest results in losing friendship with the NPC who requested it[/size]
[*][size=3]New dialogue from NPCs when you fail to complete their quests (and sometimes their friends' quests too!)[/size]
[*][size=3]Mail from Lewis when you break your promises too many times[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Configuration
[/size]
[size=3]I recommend installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for configuration options. You can enable/disable certain quest types as well as individual special orders conveniently from that menu in-game, as well as change the friendship point penalty.[/size]

Source available on [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/FailedQuestsLoseFriendship]GitHub[/url]. See the [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/blob/main/FailedQuestsLoseFriendship/docs/mod-author-guide.md]Author Guide[/url] for help adding your own dialogue for custom NPCs or quests/Special Orders.

Downloads.Description: Adds default dialogue! Now, all NPCs, vanilla or not, will have something to say when you fail a quest. This version requires Conversation Topic Utilities as a dependency. See the requirements section to download it.

Manifest.Name: Failed Quests Lose Friendship
Manifest.Description: Failing to complete help wanted quests or special orders results in a loss of friendship.
Manifest.Author: BarleyZP
